conservative.read: This conservative approach targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also limited upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk management. It seeks a blend of broad market exposure and quality tech, with controlled leverage and moderate drawdowns.
